verses.original: וַאֲנִי֙ בִּשְׁנַ֣ת אַחַ֔ת לְדָרְיָ֖וֶשׁ הַמָּדִ֑י עָמְדִ֛י לְמַחֲזִ֥יק וּלְמָע֖וֹז לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·nî biš·naṯ ’a·ḥaṯ lə·ḏā·rə·yā·weš ham·mā·ḏî ‘ā·mə·ḏî lə·ma·ḥă·zîq ū·lə·mā·‘ō·wz lōw
verses.literal: And I in the first year of Darius the Mede stood up to strengthen and protect him
verses.literalPt: EU, pois, no primeiro ano de Dario, o medo, levantei-me para animá-lo e fortalecê-lo.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֕ה אֱמֶ֖ת אַגִּ֣יד לָ֑ךְ הִנֵּה־ עוֹד֩ שְׁלֹשָׁ֨ה מְלָכִ֜ים עֹמְדִ֣ים לְפָרַ֗ס וְהָֽרְבִיעִי֙ יַעֲשִׁ֤יר עֹֽשֶׁר־ גָּדוֹל֙ מִכֹּ֔ל וּכְחֶזְקָת֣וֹ בְעָשְׁר֔וֹ יָעִ֣יר הַכֹּ֔ל אֵ֖ת מַלְכ֥וּת יָוָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh ’ĕ·meṯ ’ag·gîḏ lāḵ hin·nêh- ‘ō·wḏ šə·lō·šāh mə·lā·ḵîm ‘ō·mə·ḏîm lə·p̄ā·ras wə·hā·rə·ḇî·‘î ya·‘ă·šîr ‘ō·šer- gā·ḏō·wl mik·kōl ū·ḵə·ḥez·qā·ṯōw ḇə·‘ā·šə·rōw yā·‘îr hak·kōl ’êṯ mal·ḵūṯ yā·wān
verses.literal: Now then I will tell you the truth Three more kings will arise in Persia and then a fourth who will be far richer than all the others By the power of his wealth he will stir up everyone against the kingdom of Greece
verses.literalPt: E agora te declararei a verdade: Eis que ainda três reis estarão na Pérsia, e o quarto acumulará grandes riquezas, mais do que todos; e, tornando-se forte, por suas riquezas, suscitará a todos contra o reino da Grécia.

verses.original: וְעָמַ֖ד מֶ֣לֶךְ גִּבּ֑וֹר וּמָשַׁל֙ מִמְשָׁ֣ל רַ֔ב וְעָשָׂ֖ה כִּרְצוֹנֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·maḏ me·leḵ gib·bō·wr ū·mā·šal mim·šāl raḇ wə·‘ā·śāh kir·ṣō·w·nōw
verses.literal: Then a mighty king will arise who will rule with great authority and do as he pleases
verses.literalPt: Depois se levantará um rei valente, que reinará com grande domínio, e fará o que lhe aprouver.

verses.original: וּכְעָמְדוֹ֙ תִּשָּׁבֵ֣ר מַלְכוּת֔וֹ וְתֵחָ֕ץ לְאַרְבַּ֖ע רוּח֣וֹת הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וְלֹ֣א לְאַחֲרִית֗וֹ וְלֹ֤א כְמָשְׁלוֹ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר מָשָׁ֔ל כִּ֤י תִנָּתֵשׁ֙ מַלְכוּת֔וֹ וְלַאֲחֵרִ֖ים מִלְּבַד־ אֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḵə·‘ā·mə·ḏōw tiš·šā·ḇêr mal·ḵū·ṯōw wə·ṯê·ḥāṣ lə·’ar·ba‘ rū·ḥō·wṯ haš·šā·mā·yim wə·lō lə·’a·ḥă·rî·ṯōw wə·lō ḵə·mā·šə·lōw ’ă·šer mā·šāl kî ṯin·nā·ṯêš mal·ḵū·ṯōw wə·la·’ă·ḥê·rîm mil·lə·ḇaḏ- ’êl·leh
verses.literal: But as soon as he is established his kingdom will be broken up and parceled out toward the four winds of heaven It will not go to his descendants nor will it have the authority with which he ruled because his kingdom will be uprooted and given to others . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Mas, estando ele em pé, o seu reino será quebrado, e será repartido para os quatro ventos do céu; mas não para a sua posteridade, nem tampouco segundo o seu domínio com que reinou, porque o seu reino será arrancado, e passará a outros que não eles.

verses.original: וְיֶחֱזַ֥ק מֶֽלֶךְ־ הַנֶּ֖גֶב וּמִן־ שָׂרָ֑יו וְיֶחֱזַ֤ק עָלָיו֙ וּמָשָׁ֔ל מִמְשָׁ֥ל רַ֖ב מֶמְשַׁלְתּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ye·ḥĕ·zaq me·leḵ- han·ne·ḡeḇ ū·min- śā·rāw wə·ye·ḥĕ·zaq ‘ā·lāw ū·mā·šāl mim·šāl raḇ mem·šal·tōw
verses.literal: The king of the South will grow strong but one of his commanders will grow even stronger and will rule his own kingdom with great authority
verses.literalPt: E será forte o rei do sul; mas um dos seus príncipes será mais forte do que ele, e reinará poderosamente; seu domínio será grande.

verses.original: וּלְקֵ֤ץ שָׁנִים֙ יִתְחַבָּ֔רוּ וּבַ֣ת מֶֽלֶךְ־ הַנֶּ֗גֶב תָּבוֹא֙ אֶל־ מֶ֣לֶךְ הַצָּפ֔וֹן לַעֲשׂ֖וֹת מֵישָׁרִ֑ים וְלֹֽא־ תַעְצֹ֞ר כּ֣וֹחַ הַזְּר֗וֹעַ וְלֹ֤א יַעֲמֹד֙ וּזְרֹע֔וֹ וְתִנָּתֵ֨ן הִ֤יא וּמְבִיאֶ֙יהָ֙ וְהַיֹּ֣לְדָ֔הּ וּמַחֲזִקָ֖הּ בָּעִתִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·qêṣ šā·nîm yiṯ·ḥab·bā·rū ū·ḇaṯ me·leḵ- han·ne·ḡeḇ tā·ḇō·w ’el- me·leḵ haṣ·ṣā·p̄ō·wn la·‘ă·śō·wṯ mê·šā·rîm wə·lō- ṯa‘·ṣōr kō·w·aḥ haz·zə·rō·w·a‘ wə·lō ya·‘ă·mōḏ ū·zə·rō·‘ōw wə·ṯin·nā·ṯên hî ū·mə·ḇî·’e·hā wə·hay·yō·lə·ḏāh ū·ma·ḥă·zi·qāh bā·‘it·tîm
verses.literal: After some years they will form an alliance and the daughter of the king of the South will go to the king of the North to seal the agreement But his daughter will not retain her position of power . . . nor will his strength endure At that time she will be given up along with her royal escort and her father and the one who supported her
verses.literalPt: Mas, ao fim de alguns anos, eles se aliarão; e a filha do rei do sul virá ao rei do norte para fazer um tratado; mas ela não reterá a força do seu braço; nem ele persistirá, nem o seu braço, porque ela será entregue, e os que a tiverem trazido, e seu pai, e o que a fortalecia naqueles tempos.

verses.original: וְעָמַ֛ד מִנֵּ֥צֶר שָׁרָשֶׁ֖יהָ כַּנּ֑וֹ וְיָבֹ֣א אֶל־ הַחַ֗יִל וְיָבֹא֙ בְּמָעוֹז֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הַצָּפ֔וֹן וְעָשָׂ֥ה בָהֶ֖ם וְהֶחֱזִֽיק׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·maḏ min·nê·ṣer šā·rā·še·hā kan·nōw wə·yā·ḇō ’el- ha·ḥa·yil wə·yā·ḇō bə·mā·‘ō·wz me·leḵ haṣ·ṣā·p̄ō·wn wə·‘ā·śāh ḇā·hem wə·he·ḥĕ·zîq
verses.literal: But one from her family line . . . will rise up in his place come against the army of the king of the North and enter his fortress fighting and prevailing
verses.literalPt: Mas de um renovo das raízes dela um se levantará em seu lugar, e virá com o exército, e entrará na fortaleza do rei do norte, e operará contra eles, e prevalecerá.

verses.original: וְגַ֣ם אֱ‍ֽלֹהֵיהֶ֡ם עִם־ נְסִֽכֵיהֶם֩ עִם־ כְּלֵ֨י חֶמְדָּתָ֜ם כֶּ֧סֶף וְזָהָ֛ב בַּשְּׁבִ֖י יָבִ֣א מִצְרָ֑יִם וְהוּא֙ שָׁנִ֣ים יַעֲמֹ֔ד מִמֶּ֖לֶךְ הַצָּפֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡam ’ĕlō·hê·hem ‘im- nə·si·ḵê·hem ‘im- kə·lê ḥem·dā·ṯām ke·sep̄ wə·zā·hāḇ baš·šə·ḇî yā·ḇi miṣ·rā·yim wə·hū šā·nîm ya·‘ă·mōḏ mim·me·leḵ haṣ·ṣā·p̄ō·wn
verses.literal: He will take even their gods captive to Egypt with their metal images . . . and their precious vessels of silver and gold For some years he will stay away from the king of the North
verses.literalPt: Também os seus deuses com as suas imagens de fundição, com os seus objetos preciosos de prata e ouro, levará cativos para o Egito; e por alguns anos ele persistirá contra o rei do norte.

verses.original: וּבָ֗א בְּמַלְכוּת֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הַנֶּ֔גֶב וְשָׁ֖ב אֶל־ אַדְמָתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇā bə·mal·ḵūṯ me·leḵ han·ne·ḡeḇ wə·šāḇ ’el- ’aḏ·mā·ṯōw
verses.literal: who will invade the realm of the king of the South and then return to his own land
verses.literalPt: E entrará no reino o rei do sul, e tornará para a sua terra.

verses.original: וּבְנוֹ יִתְגָּר֗וּ וְאָסְפוּ֙ הֲמוֹן֙ חֲיָלִ֣ים רַבִּ֔ים וּבָ֥א ב֖וֹא וְשָׁטַ֣ף וְעָבָ֑ר וְיָשֹׁ֥ב וְיִתְגָּרוּ עַד־ מָעֻזָּה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nō yiṯ·gā·rū wə·’ā·sə·p̄ū hă·mō·wn ḥă·yā·lîm rab·bîm ū·ḇā ḇō·w wə·šā·ṭap̄ wə·‘ā·ḇār wə·yā·šōḇ wə·yiṯ·gå̄·rū ‘aḏ- må̄·ʿuz·zå̄h
verses.literal: But his sons will stir up strife and assemble a great army . . . which will advance forcefully . . . sweeping through like a flood and will again carry the battle as far as his fortress
verses.literalPt: Mas seus filhos intervirão e reunirão uma multidão de grandes forças; e virá apressadamente e inundará, e passará adiante; e, voltando levará a guerra até a sua fortaleza.

verses.original: וְיִתְמַרְמַר֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הַנֶּ֔גֶב וְיָצָ֕א וְנִלְחַ֥ם עִמּ֖וֹ עִם־ מֶ֣לֶךְ הַצָּפ֑וֹן וְהֶעֱמִיד֙ הָמ֣וֹן רָ֔ב וְנִתַּ֥ן הֶהָמ֖וֹן בְּיָדֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yiṯ·mar·mar me·leḵ han·ne·ḡeḇ wə·yā·ṣā wə·nil·ḥam ‘im·mōw ‘im- me·leḵ haṣ·ṣā·p̄ō·wn wə·he·‘ĕ·mîḏ hā·mō·wn rāḇ wə·nit·tan he·hā·mō·wn bə·yā·ḏōw
verses.literal: In a rage the king of the South will march out to fight . . . . . . the king of the North who will raise a large army but it will be delivered into the hand of his enemy
verses.literalPt: Então o rei do sul se exasperará, e sairá, e pelejará contra ele, contra o rei do norte; este porá em campo grande multidão, e aquela multidão será entregue na sua mão.

verses.original: וְנִשָּׂ֥א הֶהָמ֖וֹן יָרוּם לְבָב֑וֹ וְהִפִּ֛יל רִבֹּא֖וֹת וְלֹ֥א יָעֽוֹז׃
verses.transliteration: wə·niś·śā he·hā·mō·wn yå̄·rūm lə·ḇā·ḇōw wə·hip·pîl rib·bō·’ō·wṯ wə·lō yā·‘ō·wz
verses.literal: When the army is carried off the king of the South will be proud in heart and will cast down tens of thousands but he will not triumph
verses.literalPt: A multidão será tirada e o seu coração se elevará; mas ainda que derrubará muitos milhares, contudo não prevalecerá.

verses.original: וְשָׁב֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הַצָּפ֔וֹן וְהֶעֱמִ֣יד הָמ֔וֹן רַ֖ב מִן־ הָרִאשׁ֑וֹן וּלְקֵ֨ץ הָֽעִתִּ֤ים שָׁנִים֙ יָ֣בוֹא ב֔וֹא בְּחַ֥יִל גָּד֖וֹל וּבִרְכ֥וּשׁ רָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šāḇ me·leḵ haṣ·ṣā·p̄ō·wn wə·he·‘ĕ·mîḏ hā·mō·wn raḇ min- hā·ri·šō·wn ū·lə·qêṣ hā·‘it·tîm šā·nîm yā·ḇō·w ḇō·w bə·ḥa·yil gā·ḏō·wl ū·ḇir·ḵūš rāḇ
verses.literal: For the king of the North will raise another army larger than the first and after . . . some years he will advance . . . with a great army and many supplies
verses.literalPt: Porque o rei do norte tornará, e porá em campo uma multidão maior do que a primeira, e ao fim dos tempos, isto é, de anos, virá à pressa com grande exército e com muitas riquezas.

verses.original: וּבָעִתִּ֣ים הָהֵ֔ם רַבִּ֥ים יַֽעַמְד֖וּ עַל־ מֶ֣לֶךְ הַנֶּ֑גֶב וּבְנֵ֣י׀ פָּרִיצֵ֣י עַמְּךָ֗ יִֽנַּשְּׂא֛וּ לְהַעֲמִ֥יד חָז֖וֹן וְנִכְשָֽׁלוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇā·‘it·tîm hā·hêm rab·bîm ya·‘am·ḏū ‘al- me·leḵ han·ne·ḡeḇ ū·ḇə·nê pā·rî·ṣê ‘am·mə·ḵā yin·naś·śə·’ū lə·ha·‘ă·mîḏ ḥā·zō·wn wə·niḵ·šā·lū
verses.literal: In those times many will rise up against the king of the South Violent ones among your own people will exalt themselves in fulfillment of the vision but they will fail
verses.literalPt: E, naqueles tempos, muitos se levantarão contra o rei do sul; e os violentos dentre o teu povo se levantarão para cumprir a visão, mas eles cairão.

verses.original: וְיָבֹא֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הַצָּפ֔וֹן וְיִשְׁפֹּךְ֙ סֽוֹלֲלָ֔ה וְלָכַ֖ד עִ֣יר מִבְצָר֑וֹת וּזְרֹע֤וֹת הַנֶּ֙גֶב֙ לֹ֣א יַעֲמֹ֔דוּ וְעַם֙ מִבְחָרָ֔יו וְאֵ֥ין כֹּ֖חַ לַעֲמֹֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·ḇō me·leḵ haṣ·ṣā·p̄ō·wn wə·yiš·pōḵ sō·w·lă·lāh wə·lā·ḵaḏ ‘îr miḇ·ṣā·rō·wṯ ū·zə·rō·‘ō·wṯ han·ne·ḡeḇ lō ya·‘ă·mō·ḏū wə·‘am miḇ·ḥā·rāw wə·’ên kō·aḥ la·‘ă·mōḏ
verses.literal: Then the king of the North will come build up a siege ramp and capture a fortified city The forces of the South will not stand even their best troops will not be able to resist
verses.literalPt: E o rei do norte virá, e levantará baluartes, e tomará a cidade forte; e os braços do sul não poderão resistir, nem o seu povo escolhido, pois não haverá força para resistir.

verses.original: וְיַ֨עַשׂ הַבָּ֤א אֵלָיו֙ כִּרְצוֹנ֔וֹ וְאֵ֥ין עוֹמֵ֖ד לְפָנָ֑יו וְיַעֲמֹ֥ד בְּאֶֽרֶץ־ הַצְּבִ֖י וְכָלָ֥ה בְיָדֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ya·‘aś hab·bā ’ê·lāw kir·ṣō·w·nōw wə·’ên ‘ō·w·mêḏ lə·p̄ā·nāw wə·ya·‘ă·mōḏ bə·’e·reṣ- haṣ·ṣə·ḇî wə·ḵā·lāh ḇə·yā·ḏōw
verses.literal: The invader . . . will do as he pleases and no one will stand against him He will establish himself in the Beautiful Land with destruction in his hand
verses.literalPt: O que, pois, há de vir contra ele fará segundo a sua vontade, e ninguém poderá resistir diante dele; e estará na terra gloriosa, e por sua mão haverá destruição.

verses.original: וְיָשֵׂ֣ם׀ פָּ֠נָיו לָב֞וֹא בְּתֹ֧קֶף כָּל־ מַלְכוּת֛וֹ וִישָׁרִ֥ים עִמּ֖וֹ וְעָשָׂ֑ה וּבַ֤ת הַנָּשִׁים֙ יִתֶּן־ ל֣וֹ לְהַשְׁחִיתָ֔הּ וְלֹ֥א תַעֲמֹ֖ד וְלֹא־ ל֥וֹ תִהְיֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·śêm pā·nāw lā·ḇō·w bə·ṯō·qep̄ kāl- mal·ḵū·ṯōw wî·šā·rîm ‘im·mōw wə·‘ā·śāh ū·ḇaṯ han·nā·šîm yit·ten- lōw lə·haš·ḥî·ṯāh wə·lō ṯa·‘ă·mōḏ wə·lō- lōw ṯih·yeh
verses.literal: He will resolve . . . to come with the strength of his whole kingdom and will reach an agreement . . . with the king of the South He will give him a daughter in marriage . . . in order to overthrow the kingdom but his plan will not succeed or help him
verses.literalPt: E dirigirá o seu rosto, para vir com a potência de todo o seu reino, e com ele os retos, assim ele fará; e lhe dará uma filha das mulheres, para corrompê-la; ela, porém, não subsistirá, nem será para ele.

verses.original: וְיָשֵׁב פָּנָ֛יו לְאִיִּ֖ים וְלָכַ֣ד רַבִּ֑ים וְהִשְׁבִּ֨ית קָצִ֤ין חֶרְפָּתוֹ֙ ל֔וֹ בִּלְתִּ֥י חֶרְפָּת֖וֹ יָשִׁ֥יב לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yå̄·šēḇ pā·nāw lə·’î·yîm wə·lā·ḵaḏ rab·bîm wə·hiš·bîṯ qā·ṣîn ḥer·pā·ṯōw lōw bil·tî ḥer·pā·ṯōw yā·šîḇ lōw
verses.literal: Then he will turn his face to the coastlands and capture many of them But a commander will put an end to his reproach and will turn it back upon him
verses.literalPt: Depois virará o seu rosto para as ilhas, e tomará muitas; mas um príncipe fará cessar o seu opróbrio contra ele, e ainda fará recair sobre ele o seu opróbrio.

verses.original: וְיָשֵׁ֣ב פָּנָ֔יו לְמָעוּזֵּ֖י אַרְצ֑וֹ וְנִכְשַׁ֥ל וְנָפַ֖ל וְלֹ֥א יִמָּצֵֽא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·šêḇ pā·nāw lə·mā·‘ūz·zê ’ar·ṣōw wə·niḵ·šal wə·nā·p̄al wə·lō yim·mā·ṣê
verses.literal: After this, he will turn back . . . toward the fortresses of his own land but he will stumble and fall and be no more . . .
verses.literalPt: Virará então o seu rosto para as fortalezas da sua própria terra, mas tropeçará, e cairá, e não será achado.

verses.original: וְעָמַ֧ד עַל־ כַּנּ֛וֹ מַעֲבִ֥יר נוֹגֵ֖שׂ הֶ֣דֶר מַלְכ֑וּת וּבְיָמִ֤ים אֲחָדִים֙ יִשָּׁבֵ֔ר וְלֹ֥א בְאַפַּ֖יִם וְלֹ֥א בְמִלְחָמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·maḏ ‘al- kan·nōw ma·‘ă·ḇîr nō·w·ḡêś he·ḏer mal·ḵūṯ ū·ḇə·yā·mîm ’ă·ḥā·ḏîm yiš·šā·ḇêr wə·lō ḇə·’ap·pa·yim wə·lō ḇə·mil·ḥā·māh
verses.literal: In his place one will arise who will send out a tax collector for the glory of the kingdom but within a few days he will be destroyed though not in anger . . . or in battle
verses.literalPt: E em seu lugar se levantará quem fará passar um arrecadador pela glória do reino; mas em poucos dias será quebrantado, e isto sem ira e sem batalha.

verses.original: וְעָמַ֤ד עַל־ כַּנּוֹ֙ נִבְזֶ֔ה וְלֹא־ נָתְנ֥וּ עָלָ֖יו ה֣וֹד מַלְכ֑וּת וּבָ֣א בְשַׁלְוָ֔ה וְהֶחֱזִ֥יק מַלְכ֖וּת בַּחֲלַקְלַקּֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·maḏ ‘al- kan·nōw niḇ·zeh wə·lō- nā·ṯə·nū ‘ā·lāw hō·wḏ mal·ḵūṯ ū·ḇā ḇə·šal·wāh wə·he·ḥĕ·zîq mal·ḵūṯ ba·ḥă·laq·laq·qō·wṯ
verses.literal: In his place a despicable person will arise royal honors will not be given to him but he will come in a time of peace and seize the kingdom by intrigue
verses.literalPt: Depois se levantará em seu lugar um homem vil, ao qual não tinham dado a dignidade real; mas ele virá caladamente, e tomará o reino com engano.

verses.original: וּזְרֹע֥וֹת הַשֶּׁ֛טֶף יִשָּׁטְפ֥וּ מִלְּפָנָ֖יו וְיִשָּׁבֵ֑רוּ וְגַ֖ם נְגִ֥יד בְּרִֽית׃
verses.transliteration: ū·zə·rō·‘ō·wṯ haš·še·ṭep̄ yiš·šā·ṭə·p̄ū mil·lə·p̄ā·nāw wə·yiš·šā·ḇê·rū wə·ḡam nə·ḡîḏ bə·rîṯ
verses.literal: Then a flood of forces will be swept away before him and destroyed along with a prince of the covenant
verses.literalPt: E com os braços de uma inundação serão varridos de diante dele; e serão quebrantados, como também o príncipe da aliança.

verses.original: וּמִן־ הִֽתְחַבְּר֥וּת אֵלָ֖יו יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה מִרְמָ֑ה וְעָלָ֥ה וְעָצַ֖ם בִּמְעַט־ גּֽוֹי׃
verses.transliteration: ū·min- hiṯ·ḥab·bə·rūṯ ’ê·lāw ya·‘ă·śeh mir·māh wə·‘ā·lāh wə·‘ā·ṣam bim·‘aṭ- gō·w
verses.literal: After an alliance is made with him he will act deceitfully for he will rise to power with only a few people
verses.literalPt: E, depois do concerto com ele, usará de engano; e subirá, e se tornará forte com pouca gente.

verses.original: בְּשַׁלְוָ֞ה וּבְמִשְׁמַנֵּ֣י מְדִינָה֮ יָבוֹא֒ וְעָשָׂ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹא־ עָשׂ֤וּ אֲבֹתָיו֙ וַאֲב֣וֹת אֲבֹתָ֔יו בִּזָּ֧ה וְשָׁלָ֛ל וּרְכ֖וּשׁ לָהֶ֣ם יִבְז֑וֹר וְעַ֧ל מִבְצָרִ֛ים יְחַשֵּׁ֥ב מַחְשְׁבֹתָ֖יו וְעַד־ עֵֽת׃
verses.transliteration: bə·šal·wāh ū·ḇə·miš·man·nê mə·ḏî·nāh yā·ḇō·w wə·‘ā·śāh ’ă·šer lō- ‘ā·śū ’ă·ḇō·ṯāw wa·’ă·ḇō·wṯ ’ă·ḇō·ṯāw biz·zāh wə·šā·lāl ū·rə·ḵūš lā·hem yiḇ·zō·wr wə·‘al miḇ·ṣā·rîm yə·ḥaš·šêḇ maḥ·šə·ḇō·ṯāw wə·‘aḏ- ‘êṯ
verses.literal: In a time of peace he will invade the richest provinces and do what his fathers and forefathers . . . never did He will lavish plunder loot and wealth on his followers . . . and he will plot . . . against the strongholds but only for a time
verses.literalPt: Virá também caladamente aos lugares mais férteis da província, e fará o que nunca fizeram seus pais, nem os pais de seus pais; repartirá entre eles a presa e os despojos, e os bens, e formará os seus projetos contra as fortalezas, mas por certo tempo.

verses.original: וְיָעֵר֩ כֹּח֨וֹ וּלְבָב֜וֹ עַל־ מֶ֣לֶךְ הַנֶּגֶב֮ בְּחַ֣יִל גָּדוֹל֒ וּמֶ֣לֶךְ הַנֶּ֗גֶב יִתְגָּרֶה֙ לַמִּלְחָמָ֔ה בְּחַֽיִל־ גָּד֥וֹל וְעָצ֖וּם עַד־ מְאֹ֑ד וְלֹ֣א יַעֲמֹ֔ד כִּֽי־ יַחְשְׁב֥וּ עָלָ֖יו מַחֲשָׁבֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·‘êr kō·ḥōw ū·lə·ḇā·ḇōw ‘al- me·leḵ han·ne·ḡeḇ bə·ḥa·yil gā·ḏō·wl ū·me·leḵ han·ne·ḡeḇ yiṯ·gā·reh lam·mil·ḥā·māh bə·ḥa·yil- gā·ḏō·wl wə·‘ā·ṣūm ‘aḏ- mə·’ōḏ wə·lō ya·‘ă·mōḏ kî- yaḥ·šə·ḇū ‘ā·lāw ma·ḥă·šā·ḇō·wṯ
verses.literal: And with a large army he will stir up his power and his courage against the king of the South who . . . will mobilize . . . a very . . . large and powerful army but will not withstand the plots devised against him
verses.literalPt: E suscitará a sua força e a sua coragem contra o rei do sul com um grande exército; e o rei do sul se envolverá na guerra com um grande e mui poderoso exército; mas não subsistirá, porque maquinarão projetos contra ele.

verses.original: וְאֹכְלֵ֧י פַת־ בָּג֛וֹ יִשְׁבְּר֖וּהוּ וְחֵיל֣וֹ יִשְׁט֑וֹף וְנָפְל֖וּ חֲלָלִ֥ים רַבִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ō·ḵə·lê p̄aṯ- bā·ḡōw yiš·bə·rū·hū wə·ḥê·lōw yiš·ṭō·wp̄ wə·nā·p̄ə·lū ḥă·lā·lîm rab·bîm
verses.literal: Those who eat from his provisions will seek to destroy him his army will be swept away and many will fall slain
verses.literalPt: E os que comerem os seus alimentos o destruirão; e o exército dele será arrasado, e cairão muitos mortos.

verses.original: וּשְׁנֵיהֶ֤ם הַמְּלָכִים֙ לְבָבָ֣ם לְמֵרָ֔ע וְעַל־ שֻׁלְחָ֥ן אֶחָ֖ד כָּזָ֣ב יְדַבֵּ֑רוּ וְלֹ֣א תִצְלָ֔ח כִּי־ ע֥וֹד קֵ֖ץ לַמּוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: ū·šə·nê·hem ham·mə·lā·ḵîm lə·ḇā·ḇām lə·mê·rā‘ wə·‘al- šul·ḥān ’e·ḥāḏ kā·zāḇ yə·ḏab·bê·rū wə·lō ṯiṣ·lāḥ kî- ‘ō·wḏ qêṣ lam·mō·w·‘êḏ
verses.literal: And the two kings with their hearts bent on evil will speak lies at the same table but to no avail for still the end will come at the appointed time
verses.literalPt: Também estes dois reis terão o coração atento para fazerem o mal, e a uma mesma mesa falarão a mentira; mas isso não prosperará, porque ainda verá o fim no tempo determinado.

verses.original: וְיָשֹׁ֤ב אַרְצוֹ֙ בִּרְכ֣וּשׁ גָּד֔וֹל וּלְבָב֖וֹ עַל־ בְּרִ֣ית קֹ֑דֶשׁ וְעָשָׂ֖ה וְשָׁ֥ב לְאַרְצֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·šōḇ ’ar·ṣōw bir·ḵūš gā·ḏō·wl ū·lə·ḇā·ḇōw ‘al- bə·rîṯ qō·ḏeš wə·‘ā·śāh wə·šāḇ lə·’ar·ṣōw
verses.literal: The king of the North will return to his land with great wealth but his heart will be set against the holy covenant so he will do damage and return to his own land
verses.literalPt: Então tornará para a sua terra com muitos bens, e o seu coração será contra a santa aliança; e fará o que lhe aprouver, e tornará para a sua terra.

verses.original: לַמּוֹעֵ֥ד יָשׁ֖וּב וּבָ֣א בַנֶּ֑גֶב וְלֹֽא־ תִהְיֶ֥ה כָרִאשֹׁנָ֖ה וְכָאַחֲרֹנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lam·mō·w·‘êḏ yā·šūḇ ū·ḇā ḇan·ne·ḡeḇ wə·lō- ṯih·yeh ḵā·ri·šō·nāh wə·ḵā·’a·ḥă·rō·nāh
verses.literal: At the appointed time he will invade the South again but this time will not be like the first . . .
verses.literalPt: No tempo determinado tornará a vir em direção do sul; mas não será na última vez como foi na primeira.

verses.original: וּבָ֨אוּ ב֜וֹ צִיִּ֤ים כִּתִּים֙ וְנִכְאָ֔ה וְשָׁ֛ב וְזָעַ֥ם עַל־ בְּרִֽית־ ק֖וֹדֶשׁ וְעָשָׂ֑ה וְשָׁ֣ב וְיָבֵ֔ן עַל־ עֹזְבֵ֖י בְּרִ֥ית קֹֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇā·’ū ḇōw ṣî·yîm kit·tîm wə·niḵ·’āh wə·šāḇ wə·zā·‘am ‘al- bə·rîṯ- qō·w·ḏeš wə·‘ā·śāh wə·šāḇ wə·yā·ḇên ‘al- ‘ō·zə·ḇê bə·rîṯ qō·ḏeš
verses.literal: Ships of Kittim will come against him and he will lose heart Then he will turn back and rage against the holy covenant and do damage So he will return and show favor to those who forsake the holy covenant
verses.literalPt: Porque virão contra ele navios de Quitim, que lhe causarão tristeza; e voltará, e se indignará contra a santa aliança, e fará o que lhe aprouver; voltará e atenderá aos que tiverem abandonado a santa aliança.

verses.original: וּזְרֹעִ֖ים מִמֶּ֣נּוּ יַעֲמֹ֑דוּ וְחִלְּל֞וּ הַמִּקְדָּ֤שׁ הַמָּעוֹז֙ וְהֵסִ֣ירוּ הַתָּמִ֔יד וְנָתְנ֖וּ הַשִּׁקּ֥וּץ מְשׁוֹמֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·zə·rō·‘îm mim·men·nū ya·‘ă·mō·ḏū wə·ḥil·lə·lū ham·miq·dāš ham·mā·‘ō·wz wə·hê·sî·rū hat·tā·mîḏ wə·nā·ṯə·nū haš·šiq·qūṣ mə·šō·w·mêm
verses.literal: His forces will rise up and desecrate the temple fortress They will abolish the daily sacrifice and set up the abomination of desolation
verses.literalPt: E braços serão colocados sobre ele, que profanarão o santuário e a fortaleza, e tirarão o sacrifício contínuo, estabelecendo abominação desoladora.

verses.original: וּמַרְשִׁיעֵ֣י בְרִ֔ית יַחֲנִ֖יף בַּחֲלַקּ֑וֹת וְעַ֛ם יֹדְעֵ֥י אֱלֹהָ֖יו יַחֲזִ֥קוּ וְעָשֽׂוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mar·šî·‘ê ḇə·rîṯ ya·ḥă·nîp̄ ba·ḥă·laq·qō·wṯ wə·‘am yō·ḏə·‘ê ’ĕ·lō·hāw ya·ḥă·zi·qū wə·‘ā·śū
verses.literal: With flattery he will corrupt those who violate the covenant but the people who know their God will firmly resist him
verses.literalPt: E aos violadores da aliança ele com lisonjas perverterá, mas o povo que conhece ao seu Deus se tornará forte e fará proezas.

verses.original: וּמַשְׂכִּ֣ילֵי עָ֔ם יָבִ֖ינוּ לָֽרַבִּ֑ים וְנִכְשְׁל֞וּ בְּחֶ֧רֶב וּבְלֶהָבָ֛ה בִּשְׁבִ֥י וּבְבִזָּ֖ה יָמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ū·maś·kî·lê ‘ām yā·ḇî·nū lā·rab·bîm wə·niḵ·šə·lū bə·ḥe·reḇ ū·ḇə·le·hā·ḇāh biš·ḇî ū·ḇə·ḇiz·zāh yā·mîm
verses.literal: Those with insight . . . will instruct many though for a time they will fall by sword or flame or be captured or plundered
verses.literalPt: E os entendidos entre o povo ensinarão a muitos; todavia cairão pela espada, e pelo fogo, e pelo cativeiro, e pelo roubo, por muitos dias.

verses.original: וּבְהִכָּ֣שְׁלָ֔ם יֵעָזְר֖וּ עֵ֣זֶר מְעָ֑ט וְנִלְו֧וּ עֲלֵיהֶ֛ם רַבִּ֖ים בַּחֲלַקְלַקּֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·hik·kā·šə·lām yê·‘ā·zə·rū ‘ê·zer mə·‘āṭ wə·nil·wū ‘ă·lê·hem rab·bîm ba·ḥă·laq·laq·qō·wṯ
verses.literal: Now when they fall they will be granted a little help but many will join them insincerely
verses.literalPt: E, caindo eles, serão ajudados com pequeno socorro; mas muitos se ajuntarão a eles com lisonjas.

verses.original: וּמִן־ הַמַּשְׂכִּילִ֣ים יִכָּֽשְׁל֗וּ לִצְר֥וֹף בָּהֶ֛ם וּלְבָרֵ֥ר וְלַלְבֵּ֖ן עַד־ עֵ֣ת קֵ֑ץ כִּי־ ע֖וֹד לַמּוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: ū·min- ham·maś·kî·lîm yik·kā·šə·lū liṣ·rō·wp̄ bā·hem ū·lə·ḇā·rêr wə·lal·bên ‘aḏ- ‘êṯ qêṣ kî- ‘ō·wḏ lam·mō·w·‘êḏ
verses.literal: Some of the wise will fall so that they may be refined purified and made spotless until the time of the end for it will still come at the appointed time
verses.literalPt: E alguns dos entendidos cairão, para serem provados, purificados, e embranquecidos, até ao fim do tempo, porque será ainda para o tempo determinado.

verses.original: וְעָשָׂ֨ה כִרְצוֹנ֜וֹ הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ וְיִתְרוֹמֵ֤ם וְיִתְגַּדֵּל֙ עַל־ כָּל־ אֵ֔ל וְעַל֙ אֵ֣ל אֵלִ֔ים יְדַבֵּ֖ר נִפְלָא֑וֹת וְהִצְלִ֙יחַ֙ עַד־ כָּ֣לָה זַ֔עַם כִּ֥י נֶחֱרָצָ֖ה נֶעֱשָֽׂתָה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·śāh ḵir·ṣō·w·nōw ham·me·leḵ wə·yiṯ·rō·w·mêm wə·yiṯ·gad·dêl ‘al- kāl- ’êl wə·‘al ’êl ’ê·lîm yə·ḏab·bêr nip̄·lā·’ō·wṯ wə·hiṣ·lî·aḥ ‘aḏ- kā·lāh za·‘am kî ne·ḥĕ·rā·ṣāh ne·‘ĕ·śā·ṯāh
verses.literal: Then the king will do as he pleases and will exalt and magnify himself above every god and he will speak monstrous things against the God of gods He will be successful until the time of wrath is completed for what has been decreed must be accomplished
verses.literalPt: E este rei fará conforme a sua vontade, e levantar-se-á, e engrandecer-se-á sobre todo deus; e contra o Deus dos deuses falará coisas espantosas, e será próspero, até que a ira se complete; porque aquilo que está determinado será feito.

verses.original: וְעַל־ אֱלֹהֵ֤י אֲבֹתָיו֙ לֹ֣א יָבִ֔ין וְעַל־ חֶמְדַּ֥ת נָשִׁ֛ים וְעַֽל־ כָּל־ אֱל֖וֹהַּ לֹ֣א יָבִ֑ין כִּ֥י עַל־ כֹּ֖ל יִתְגַּדָּֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘al- ’ĕ·lō·hê ’ă·ḇō·ṯāw lō yā·ḇîn wə·‘al- ḥem·daṯ nā·šîm wə·‘al- kāl- ’ĕ·lō·w·ah lō yā·ḇîn kî ‘al- kōl yiṯ·gad·dāl
verses.literal: He will show no regard for the gods of his fathers nor for the one desired by women nor for any other god . . . . . . because he will magnify himself above them all
verses.literalPt: E não terá respeito ao Deus de seus pais, nem terá respeito ao amor das mulheres, nem a deus algum, porque sobre tudo se engrandecerá.

verses.original: וְלֶאֱלֹ֙הַּ֙ מָֽעֻזִּ֔ים עַל־ כַּנּ֖וֹ יְכַבֵּ֑ד וְלֶאֱל֜וֹהַּ אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹא־ יְדָעֻ֣הוּ אֲבֹתָ֗יו יְכַבֵּ֛ד בְּזָהָ֥ב וּבְכֶ֛סֶף וּבְאֶ֥בֶן יְקָרָ֖ה וּבַחֲמֻדֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·le·’ĕ·lō·ah mā·‘uz·zîm ‘al- kan·nōw yə·ḵab·bêḏ wə·le·’ĕ·lō·w·ah ’ă·šer lō- yə·ḏā·‘u·hū ’ă·ḇō·ṯāw yə·ḵab·bêḏ bə·zā·hāḇ ū·ḇə·ḵe·sep̄ ū·ḇə·’e·ḇen yə·qā·rāh ū·ḇa·ḥă·mu·ḏō·wṯ
verses.literal: And in their place he will honor a god of fortresses a god his fathers . . . did not know with gold silver precious stones and riches
verses.literalPt: Mas em seu lugar honrará a um deus das forças; e a um deus a quem seus pais não conheceram honrará com ouro, e com prata, e com pedras preciosas, e com coisas agradáveis.

verses.original: וְעָשָׂ֞ה לְמִבְצְרֵ֤י מָֽעֻזִּים֙ עִם־ אֱל֣וֹהַּ נֵכָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִכִּיר יַרְבֶּ֣ה כָב֑וֹד וְהִמְשִׁילָם֙ בָּֽרַבִּ֔ים וַאֲדָמָ֖ה יְחַלֵּ֥ק בִּמְחִֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·śāh lə·miḇ·ṣə·rê mā·‘uz·zîm ‘im- ’ĕ·lō·w·ah nê·ḵār ’ă·šer hik·kīr yar·beh ḵā·ḇō·wḏ wə·him·šî·lām bā·rab·bîm wa·’ă·ḏā·māh yə·ḥal·lêq bim·ḥîr
verses.literal: He will attack the strongest fortresses . . . with the help of a foreign god and will greatly honor those who acknowledge him making them rulers over many and distributing the land for a price
verses.literalPt: Com o auxílio de um deus estranho agirá contra as poderosas fortalezas; aos que o reconhecerem multiplicará a honra, e os fará reinar sobre muitos, e repartirá a terra por preço.

verses.original: וּבְעֵ֣ת קֵ֗ץ יִתְנַגַּ֤ח עִמּוֹ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הַנֶּ֔גֶב וְיִשְׂתָּעֵ֨ר עָלָ֜יו מֶ֣לֶךְ הַצָּפ֗וֹן בְּרֶ֙כֶב֙ וּבְפָ֣רָשִׁ֔ים וּבָאֳנִיּ֖וֹת רַבּ֑וֹת וּבָ֥א בַאֲרָצ֖וֹת וְשָׁטַ֥ף וְעָבָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·‘êṯ qêṣ yiṯ·nag·gaḥ ‘im·mōw me·leḵ han·ne·ḡeḇ wə·yiś·tā·‘êr ‘ā·lāw me·leḵ haṣ·ṣā·p̄ō·wn bə·re·ḵeḇ ū·ḇə·p̄ā·rā·šîm ū·ḇā·’o·nî·yō·wṯ rab·bō·wṯ ū·ḇā ḇa·’ă·rā·ṣō·wṯ wə·šā·ṭap̄ wə·‘ā·ḇār
verses.literal: At the time of the end the king of the South will engage him in battle . . . but the king of the North will storm out against him with chariots horsemen and many ships invading many countries and sweeping through them like a flood
verses.literalPt: E, no fim do tempo, o rei do sul lutará com ele, e o rei do norte se levantará contra ele com carros, e com cavaleiros, e com muitos navios; e entrará nas suas terras e as inundará, e passará.

verses.original: וּבָא֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ הַצְּבִ֔י וְרַבּ֖וֹת יִכָּשֵׁ֑לוּ וְאֵ֙לֶּה֙ יִמָּלְט֣וּ מִיָּד֔וֹ אֱד֣וֹם וּמוֹאָ֔ב וְרֵאשִׁ֖ית בְּנֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇā bə·’e·reṣ haṣ·ṣə·ḇî wə·rab·bō·wṯ yik·kā·šê·lū wə·’êl·leh yim·mā·lə·ṭū mî·yā·ḏōw ’ĕ·ḏō·wm ū·mō·w·’āḇ wə·rê·šîṯ bə·nê ‘am·mō·wn
verses.literal: He will also invade the Beautiful Land and many countries will fall But these will be delivered from his hand Edom Moab and the leaders of the Ammonites . . .
verses.literalPt: E entrará na terra gloriosa, e muitos países cairão, mas da sua mão escaparão estes: Edom e Moabe, e os chefes dos filhos de Amom.

verses.original: וְיִשְׁלַ֥ח יָד֖וֹ בַּאֲרָצ֑וֹת וְאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם לֹ֥א תִהְיֶ֖ה לִפְלֵיטָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yiš·laḥ yā·ḏōw ba·’ă·rā·ṣō·wṯ wə·’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim lō ṯih·yeh lip̄·lê·ṭāh
verses.literal: He will extend his power over many countries and not even . . . the land of Egypt will escape
verses.literalPt: E estenderá a sua mão contra os países, e a terra do Egito não escapará.

verses.original: וּמָשַׁ֗ל בְּמִכְמַנֵּי֙ הַזָּהָ֣ב וְהַכֶּ֔סֶף וּבְכֹ֖ל חֲמֻד֣וֹת מִצְרָ֑יִם וְלֻבִ֥ים וְכֻשִׁ֖ים בְּמִצְעָדָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mā·šal bə·miḵ·man·nê haz·zā·hāḇ wə·hak·ke·sep̄ ū·ḇə·ḵōl ḥă·mu·ḏō·wṯ miṣ·rā·yim wə·lu·ḇîm wə·ḵu·šîm bə·miṣ·‘ā·ḏāw
verses.literal: He will gain control of the treasures of gold and silver and over all the riches of Egypt and the Libyans and Cushites will also submit to him
verses.literalPt: E apoderar-se-á dos tesouros de ouro e de prata e de todas as coisas preciosas do Egito; e os líbios e os etíopes o seguirão.

verses.original: וּשְׁמֻע֣וֹת יְבַהֲלֻ֔הוּ מִמִּזְרָ֖ח וּמִצָּפ֑וֹן וְיָצָא֙ בְּחֵמָ֣א גְדֹלָ֔ה לְהַשְׁמִ֥יד וּֽלְהַחֲרִ֖ים רַבִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ū·šə·mu·‘ō·wṯ yə·ḇa·hă·lu·hū mim·miz·rāḥ ū·miṣ·ṣā·p̄ō·wn wə·yā·ṣā bə·ḥê·mā ḡə·ḏō·lāh lə·haš·mîḏ ū·lə·ha·ḥă·rîm rab·bîm
verses.literal: But news from the east and the north will alarm him and he will go out with great fury to destroy many and devote them to destruction
verses.literalPt: Mas os rumores do oriente e do norte o espantarão; e sairá com grande furor, para destruir e extirpar a muitos.

verses.original: וְיִטַּע֙ אָהֳלֶ֣י אַפַּדְנ֔וֹ בֵּ֥ין יַמִּ֖ים לְהַר־ צְבִי־ קֹ֑דֶשׁ וּבָא֙ עַד־ קִצּ֔וֹ וְאֵ֥ין עוֹזֵ֖ר לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yiṭ·ṭa‘ ’ā·ho·le ’ap·paḏ·nōw bên yam·mîm lə·har- ṣə·ḇî- qō·ḏeš ū·ḇā ‘aḏ- qiṣ·ṣōw wə·’ên ‘ō·w·zêr lōw
verses.literal: He will pitch his royal tents between the sea and the beautiful holy mountain but he will meet . . . his end with no one to help him
verses.literalPt: E armará as tendas do seu palácio entre o mar grande e o monte santo e glorioso; mas chegará ao seu fim, e não haverá quem o socorra.
